\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

4-2. Suppose $M$ is a smooth manifold (without boundary), $N$ is a smooth manifold with boundary, and $F : M \rightarrow N$ is smooth. Show that if $p \in M$ is a point such that $d{F}_{p}$ is nonsingular, then $F\left( p\right) \in $ Int $N$ . (Used on pp. 80,87.) \end{exercise}
